  • 2,600+ NCLEX® Questions, vague like the real exam
  • 50 NCLEX® Cases with video explanations
  • Crash Course Videos covering the most tested concepts

  • 4.9+ ★ Rated Mobile App available on iOS and Android.
  • And an NCLEX® Pass Guarantee!
I'm already using another NCLEX® question bank. How is NCLEX Bootcamp different?

The Next Gen NCLEX® is an updated test, and you need to prepare with an updated question bank. NCLEX Bootcamp is the only nursing resource created specifically for the Next Gen NCLEX®.

The Next Gen change means that the test now requires clinical judgment, and you can’t develop clinical judgment just by reading explanations alone. Instead, our video case walkthroughs and our Next Gen strategy course teach you how to think like a nurse and how to prioritize, which are the most important skills you need for NCLEX® success. Our question bank gives you plenty of opportunity to practice those skills.
Who made NCLEX Bootcamp?

NCLEX Bootcamp is made by a small team of passionate nurse educators who are committed to creating the best NCLEX® prep tool – period. We come from all different clinical specialties and teaching backgrounds, but we are all masters - or doctorally-prepared nurses who share a common desire to help teach clinical judgment to future nurses (like you!).
Does NCLEX Bootcamp have a pass guarantee?

Yes! Our NCLEX Bootcamp 2 month and 3 month options comes with a pass guarantee.

If you fail the NCLEX® after meeting all three of your Pass Targets, just email us at team@bootcamp.com and we'll refund your entire payment.

Eligibility:

  1. Purchase of NCLEX Bootcamp 2 month or 3 month must be made at least 30 days before your exam date.
  2. Meet all three Pass Targets on your Performance page before your exam.
  3. Provide the name of your accredited nursing program in the US or Canada, and results notifying you of your attempt failure.

performance: Your score is calculated based on the result of every question you attempt. You can answer each question as many times as you’d like. Every correct answer will increase your average score.
Can I reset my score for each subject?
Not at the moment. However, you can answer each question as many times as you’d like. Every correct answer will increase your average score.
Can I reset or untag my used questions?
Not at the moment. Once a question is used, it remains used. However, you can answer each question as many times as you'd like and change the tag each time.
Are Case Studies and Readiness Exam included in my performance?
Yes, Case Studies and Readiness Exam scores and questions used are included.
readiness: What are NCLEX® Bootcamp Readiness Exams?

Readiness exams simulate the exact look, feel, and content of the real NCLEX®. At the end of each exam, you’ll get an accurate prediction of how likely you are to pass the NCLEX® and recommendations on how to improve your chances of passing.
How many questions are in each NCLEX® Bootcamp Readiness Exam?
Readiness exams include 100 unique NGN and traditional questions based on the NCLEX-RN test plan.
How long are the NCLEX® Bootcamp Readiness Exams?
You will have 3 hours and 20 minutes to complete 100 questions, similar to the pace you should answer questions on the real NCLEX®.
How accurate are the NCLEX® Bootcamp Readiness Exams?

We use statistical models to compare your performance against previous students who passed the NCLEX® to determine your readiness level. As shown in our Facebook study group, many students have confirmed the Readiness Exams accurately predicted their NCLEX® results.
When should I take my first NCLEX® Bootcamp Readiness Exam?

We highly recommend taking a readiness exam at the start of your studying to see where your strengths and weaknesses are, and then practicing with the question bank to improve your weaker subjects. Take another readiness exam at the mid-point of your studying, and another one just before the NCLEX® to gauge your readiness.
Can I pause a Readiness Exam and come back to it later?
Yes, you can pause a Readiness Exam and come back to it later. Just keep in mind that you won't be able to pause on the actual NCLEX®
schedule: Why should I use the study schedule creator?

Students who use a study schedule score higher than those that don’t. But PDF study schedules are rigid and annoying to use. So we took our proven NCLEX® study schedule PDF and turned it into an interactive customizable calendar!
  • Select your start and exam date, and the schedule creator will create a personalized study schedule for you.
  • Easily customize your schedule by adding days off, moving assignments, or changing your exam date.
  • If you fall behind, click rebalance and the schedule creator will evenly distribute your overdue assignments up to your exam date.
This schedule will help you stay organized and on track to exam day. Create a personalized schedule today and get started!
I already started the PDF schedule. How can I switch to the study schedule creator?

You can still use the study schedule creator even if you’ve started the PDF schedule!
  1. Create a schedule with today as your start date.
  2. Mark all the assignments you've already done as complete.
  3. Then click Rebalance, and the study schedule will evenly spread your remaining assignments up to your exam date.
The study schedule will evenly distribute your remaining assignments up to your exam date like magic!
Is this the same as the PDF study schedule?

Yes. There is no difference in content, they both have the same assignments and the same order. We recommend using the study schedule creator so you can customize the schedule to your study dates and easily update it. You can view the original Study Schedule PDF here.
What if I fall behind or need to change something?

No worries, you can click rebalance and the schedule creator will evenly distribute your overdue assignments up to your exam date. You can move assignments, take days off, adjust your study speed, or change your exam date. You’re in full control.
